input: Annual transport cost for the returns flow is $469k. The figure is built from 571 km per trip at $1.22 per km across 673 trips per year, and each element comes from the same base: carrier invoices for the last 12 months. The trip count includes empty running, so the cost covers the full movement the returns flow generates, loaded and empty together, and not loaded movement alone. On that basis the annual figure is complete for the flow as currently run. A change in the trip count or in the carrier rate moves the annual cost directly; the distance is set by the route, and no element of the total is estimated rather than invoiced. The 12-month base also fixes the pattern behind the total: the rate, the trip count and the distance are recent actual values, and each holds only while the route, the carrier and the returns volume hold. A renegotiated rate supersedes the rate per kilometre; a route change supersedes the distance; a sustained change in returns volume supersedes the trip count. Until one of those changes is made, the annual plan takes the returns flow cost as $469k, and a comparison against any alternative arrangement is made on the same invoice basis.
